headers.rounds_zero: (M : Matrix) (d : List Cell) : rounds M 0 d = d
headers.rounds_succ:
(M : Matrix) (k : ℕ) (d : List Cell) :
    rounds M (k+1) d = rounds M k (rows d M d)
headers.best_assoc: (a b c : Cell) : best (best a b) c=best a (best b c)
headers.best_comm: (a b : Cell) : best a b=best b a
headers.scan_best:
(r d : List Cell) (a b : Cell) :
    scan r d (best a b)=best (scan r d a) b
headers.scan_eq_fold:
(r d : List Cell) (z : Cell) :
    scan r d z=(List.zipWith addCell r d).foldr best z
headers.rows_length:
(M : Matrix) (d ds : List Cell) :
    (rows d M ds).length=min M.length ds.length

suffix_only_change.new:
change scan xs ys (best (addCell x y) z) =
        best (addCell x y) ((List.zipWith addCell xs ys).foldr best z)
